package.name: omni_arm
package.description: omni-robot (design.md 11): the SO-101 arm on the robot's nose. arm_node owns the servo bus (six STS3215 on a USB bus board, or the sim's bus over TCP), publishes the joints and the arm's links, plays joint trajectories (control_msgs FollowJointTrajectory when installed) and runs the tidy task (find small things on the floor with the stereo depth, pick each with the wrist camera's help, drop it in the bin). The cores (kinematics, feetech, driver, motion, floor_vision, wrist_vision, pick) have no ROS in them; the sim's harness runs them directly.
